# Copilot instructions for TrendWave

## Commit conventions

- Do **not** add a `Co-authored-by: Copilot` trailer — or any other Copilot
  author/co-author attribution — to commit messages. Commits made with Copilot
  assistance should be attributed solely to the human author.
- This applies to every commit on every branch, including those opened as pull
  requests, so Copilot never appears in the repository's contributors list.
